The last real campaign commit is still the BDX red team of 2026-09-15, 25 days back. Three more indicators tripped, all price-based, and all on chains with no dive: DKNG fell through its 20.72 trip level (prediction-market-plumbing S5, 19.60 on 2026-10-05, second S5 trip on that chain after VIRT), NVDA printed a new 52-week high (neocloud-export-compliance S3, 239.24 on 2026-10-06) and Vopak closed at 51.05 EUR (methanol-bunkering S3, 2026-10-07). CALM also printed a new low (64.99 on 2026-10-05) after its S3 trip. ACM, the only INVESTABLE name, cannot be re-checked: its price file was last refreshed 2026-10-03 and its last print is 59.66 on 2026-10-02, still under the 61.00 entry floor, so the read is eight days old. Stale or silent, named: radar (a fifth week without intake; the IMO MEPC vote of 2026-10-01 is still unswept so the methanol chain's central event is unknown to the machine); campaign (ATI-INC never dived, two chains still carrying the wrong stage); the CALM, GLEN.L, WSP.TO and ACM price files lag the fetch rotation by 4 to 8 days; seven of nine agents (adam-gm, atlas-cartographer, hitch-harness, nell-scanner, sieve-profiler, stocky, tally-appraiser) show no ledger evidence in 21 days because the pause removed their work. Date pressure: SIG-20260828-02 (Tibet mega-dam) reaches review_by 2026-10-15, SIG-20260901-02 (rare earth) is 19 days past its review_by with the suspension expiry on 2026-11-10, 31 days out. No dive is past review_by (GD and WST 2026-10-30). Shadow book: 81 rows, none graded. Deferred backlog holds at 106 OPEN, no new rows this week.

ranked.title: Two more methanol-chain indicators moved while the IMO vote outcome is still unknown to the machine
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-04 rests on the divergence between the IMO Net-Zero Framework postponement (the card cites the 57 to 49 to 21 vote) and Singapore's methanol-bunkering licences running 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31 regardless. EVT-20260901-01 in data/calendar/events.json, the reconvened MEPC session dated 2026-10-01, is still WATCHING because radar, the stage that sweeps the calendar, is paused. Meanwhile the chain's indicators now point two ways: S5 (shipyard rally cools, not on an IMO event) is tripped by HD Korea Shipbuilding (009540.KS) at 323,500 KRW on 2026-10-02, equal to its 52-week low, and S3 (IMO lands ambiguous, regional clocks compound) is tripped by Royal Vopak (VPK.AS) at 51.05 EUR on 2026-10-07, a new 52-week high above the 49.00 trip level. S3 is the chain's own base thesis, the vote delayed but nothing else waited; the shipyard weakness and the terminal strength are separate reads. One lookup of the vote result would tell you which scenario the machine should be weighting. No dive exists on this chain, so no verdict moves; its one instrument (KRBN) is still unrated.

ranked.title: Both listed consumer proxies on the prediction-market chain have now tripped the same disappointment scenario
ranked.case: SIG-20260830-03 was scored 58 on unmappedness precisely because the occurrence was saturated and the gap is the plumbing, not the event. The chain's S5 scenario ("The pool disappoints") argues the legal question resolves and turns out not to matter because demand was smaller than the extrapolation from growth off a tiny base. Its indicators have now tripped twice: VIRT at 60.86 on 2026-09-11 (back to its June level, event-contract flow not an incremental earner) and, new this week, DKNG at 19.60 on 2026-10-05, through the 20.72 trip level (the file's 52-week low is 18.59, so it has not made a new low). Latest prints: DKNG 19.75 (2026-10-06), VIRT 58.81 (2026-10-07) and 57.81 (2026-10-08). Two independent names saying the same thing is the first market read on the card's own bear case. The chain is still CHAINED with 0 O1, all 13 profiled names blocked on NULL canonical fields or an exposure hold, and the page ranks its player-eligibility-gate link third overall with no listed issuer yet, so there is nothing to act on, only a scenario to re-weight.

ranked.title: The rare-earth suspension expires in 31 days and the card's own review date is 19 days overdue
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-02 (EVENT clock, review_by 2026-09-21, unmappedness 58) rests on MOFCOM's suspension of the rare-earth export-control announcements expiring 2026-11-10 (EVT-20260831-02, status PROMOTED). Tally's appraisal IMP-20260830-16 put it in the LEAKY band with public_reach 40 and found only one confirmed listed name with described capacity (Neo Performance Materials), Ucore pre-commercial, and the status of Vacuumschmelze and Solvay unestablished across two passes. The S1 indicator on the chain (300748.SZ staying under 32.0) tripped on 2026-09-14 at 24.78 and has not been refreshed. Nothing has re-examined the card since the date was set; the decision date is the one forcing event on this list with a hard calendar edge, and it now falls inside the window where a decision can still be made before it.

ranked.title: NVDA at a new high is the market pricing the chain's most-discovered link, not the unmapped one
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-01 held its unmappedness at 74, not higher, because the top-level China AI-chip narrative is crowded and Nvidia itself is the only large listed name in the story, the exact trap the card names. The chain's S3 indicator (Nvidia prints a new 52-week high as a compliance-differentiation mandate is priced as incremental share protection) tripped on 2026-10-06 at 239.24 against the 235.74 trip level; the latest print is 237.47 (2026-10-07). That is the read S3 predicted for the discovered end of the chain and says nothing about the compliance-verification, KYC and requalification layer the card actually bets on, which still has no listed issuer named and where the operative Southeast Asian actors the card found are private. Treat the trip as confirmation that the visible link is fully priced, a reason to keep looking at the other links, not a reason to look at NVDA.

ranked.title: Tibet mega-dam hits its review date on 2026-10-15 with two FINAL WATCH dives hanging off it
ranked.case: SIG-20260828-02 (unmappedness 88, the highest on a chain with dives) reaches review_by 2026-10-15, five days out, and carries two FINAL WATCH dives, 688425.SS (tunneling TBM) and ANDR.VI (global hydro spillover), both with review_by 2026-11-30 and no would_buy_zone. The card's own stated open question is investability, since most of the exposed set is Chinese state-owned. The dives answered it narrowly: a Shanghai-listed TBM maker and an Austrian hydro equipment name, both WATCH, neither with a price zone. No new evidence landed this week, so the review is a calendar item, not a thesis change; it is the nearest signal review that is not already overdue.
